name: KBC Group NV
summary: KBC Group NV, together with its subsidiaries, provides banking, insurance, and asset management services in Belgium, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Hungary, and Slovakia. The company offers demand deposits, time deposits, and savings and current accounts; home and mortgage loans; home insurance; consumer finance and SME funding services, investment fund, and life and non-life insurance; cash management, payments, trade finance, leasing, corporate finance, money and capital market products; and other financial services, such as factoring and stockbroking services.
